description: It reassigns the relationship. A customer, a colleague or a patient becomes someone junior, familiar and slightly comic. It is done in one word and takes no time at all.

aspect: It has a name and a literature
description: This is benevolent sexism in Glick and Fiske's sense: subjectively positive attitudes toward women in traditional roles, built on protective paternalism - viewing women as not fully competent adults - and serving the same hierarchy as the hostile form.
energy_note: Warm, well-meant, and doing exactly the same work as contempt.
notes: Glick & Fiske, Ambivalent Sexism Inventory, JPSP 1996.

aspect: The asymmetry is the whole of it
description: He calls her babe. She cannot call him babe. If the term were genuinely friendly it would be reciprocal, and it never is - which is how the target knows what it is, and cannot prove it.
energy_note: Try saying it back and watch what happens.

description: In front of colleagues or other customers, the objection is the disruptive event. The person who said it becomes the reasonable party and the person who objected becomes difficult, humourless or aggressive.
energy_note: Whoever mentions it is the one who caused a scene.

description: Sue's point is that a remark can be a microinsult the first time and a microassault by the third, because by then the speaker has been told. Intent stops being available as a defence and continues to be used as one.
energy_note: The first time it is careless. The fourth time it is a decision.

aspect: It is the audible part of an inaudible pattern
description: The same person who says babe also interrupts, explains her own field to her, and addresses the man beside her when answering her question. The word is reportable and trivial; the pattern is serious and unreportable.
energy_note: The only bit you can point at is the bit that sounds smallest.

description: Fourth visit about the same billing error. 'Alright babe, let's have a look.' He is friendly. He fixes it. She has been coming back for three weeks and has been called babe by him each time, and if she says anything the friendliness will stop and the billing error will take longer.
energy_note: The helpfulness is conditional and both of them know it.
